summary: At the southern watchtower, Mountaineer Cobbleflint calls for help as Stonesplinter troggs press toward the Valley of Kings. Ironforge’s forces serve on distant fronts.

sections.title: A Thin Line in the Valley of Kings
sections.body: Cobbleflint and the guards are too few to stop the growing trogg invasion beneath the great dwarven monuments. King Magni Bronzebeard has sent much of his regular army abroad to support the Alliance. Local patrols and hired blades must keep the province from being overrun.

sections.title: The Stonesplinter Incursion
sections.body: Stonesplinter Valley cuts through Loch Modan’s southern peaks, where troggs have burrowed up from the depths. Their scouts reconnoiter the roads while warriors build camps along the valley floor. If left unchecked, their parties threaten the roads to the southern passes. The Mountaineers must fight them without pause.

faq.q: Why is the garrison in Loch Modan so undermanned?
faq.answer: King Magni Bronzebeard has sent much of Ironforge’s military to distant Alliance battlefields and outposts across Azeroth. Loch Modan and other home territories rely mainly on light Mountaineer patrols, which call on travelers to help hold back regional invasions.

Mountaineer Cobbleflint is a dwarven sentry at the southern guard tower in the Valley of Kings. He coordinates security along Loch Modan’s southern boundary and directs attacks against the trogg tribes.
Stonesplinter Valley lies south of Thelsamar. Its entrance is near the main road, before the massive dwarven statues in the Valley of Kings, and the troggs keep several camps along its rocky floor.

faq.q: What makes troggs such a severe threat to the dwarves?
faq.answer: Troggs tunnel through solid rock and can bypass surface walls and fortifications. They may burst up beneath roads, settlements, and mines, putting Ironforge’s security at risk.

faq.q: Who do I speak to after helping Cobbleflint?
faq.answer: After you thin the Stonesplinter troggs and scouts, Cobbleflint sends you to Mountaineer Gravelgaw. He is just inside the adjacent watchtower and manages the next patrol along the valley front.
The Stonesplinter clan sends specialized scouts to reconnoiter the roads while foot soldiers hold defensive camps throughout the ravine.

angles.text: As a dwarf, answering Cobbleflint’s call helps defend King Magni’s ancestral valleys from subterranean pests while the army fights elsewhere.
As an Alliance adventurer, helping secure the Valley of Kings answers Ironforge’s call while dwarven troops serve on distant allied fronts.
As a hunter, you can use the crags and outcroppings of Stonesplinter Valley to target trogg sentries and scouts from high ground.
